- formal layout: the binary that ships, with the run error pooled over every unit.
- mean of the layouts: each layout of the plan with the same weight. Its interval treats this fixed, chosen set of layouts as if it were a random sample of the places a change can land, which nothing has shown.
- these layouts only: the same mean with the run error alone, how well these very layouts were measured.
- run SD and layout SD are estimates that assume independent run errors of one variance, after taking out the order effect. A layout SD of 0 does not show that the change is the same at every layout.
